_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd the_isle/evrima/egg-the-isle.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail keeps the Linux server of the evrima branch (app 412680, -beta evrima also on every automatic update, so the server never falls back to Legacy) and the public Epic Online Services client the game's own server guide gives (passed on the command line as upstream does), and changes the rest: Game.ini is edited before every start with the ini parser (upstream overwrote the whole file at every reinstall, admins included, and set nothing at start), so settings and lines the owner adds survive; RCON and queue ports come from automatic port variables (+1 and +2) instead of upstream's shared 44000; RCON is off and its password is required to be one word; the password switch follows the password variable's own true/false setting; the map is a setting; the stop is Ctrl+C (upstream's ^^C was a kill) and the no_console_input flag hides the command box (the server reads no console commands; its RCON is The Isle's own protocol, not Source RCON); the start also counts once the game port (UDP) is bound; install sandbox defaults and resource hints; and the install fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: The Isle (Evrima)
author: fredrik.johansenfuun@gmail.com
description: The Isle is an open-world survival game: play as a dinosaur on a hostile island. Hunt. Prey. Survive. This is the Evrima branch's Linux dedicated server.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SteamCMD installation script (Octail)
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Variables: SRCDS_APPID (the app), SRCDS_BETAID / SRCDS_BETAPASS (a beta branch), anonymous login.

## anonymous login: these servers need no Steam account
STEAM_USER=anonymous
STEAM_PASS=""
STEAM_AUTH=""

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/TheIsle/Binaries/Linux/TheIsleServer-Linux-Shipping" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the The Isle (Evrima) dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x "/mnt/server/TheIsle/Binaries/Linux/TheIsleServer-Linux-Shipping"

## Game.ini is filled before every start (Octail's ini parser); its folder must exist
mkdir -p /mnt/server/TheIsle/Saved/Config/LinuxServer

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server list.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server loads (Gateway is Evrima's map).

variables.name: Password Required
variables.description: true: players need the Server Password to join.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: The join password (letters, digits, - and _), used when Password Required is true.

variables.name: Queue
variables.description: true: players wait in a queue when the server is full.

variables.name: Allow Replay
variables.description: true: players may replay as a new dinosaur after death.

variables.name: Discord
variables.description: An optional Discord invite code shown in the server list.

variables.name: RCON
variables.description: true: The Isle's own RCON listens on the RCON port (for tools made for The Isle; set a password first).

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: The RCON password (8 to 64 letters, digits, - and _).

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: Set by Octail when the server is created (one after the game port).

variables.name: Queue Port
variables.description: Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: Steam Branch
variables.description: Evrima is a beta branch of the dedicated server; installs and updates stay on it.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server (on the evrima branch) at every start.
